name: fine-rod
description: Experiment, not a device: the organiser's robot and devices with both rods shortened to 0.6 m so their page resolves them finer (wire 160 bodies: 3.75 mm apart instead of 7.5 mm; catheter 80 bodies: 7.5 mm instead of 16 mm). Tests whether wall crossings come from the rod resolution (docs/SAFETY.md §7). Travel as the Monadnock; 0.6 m covers its 264.5 mm of insertion.
